I said countless times when people find out that US, Russia and China have UFOs, and unconventional weapons, you can conclude those nations do not need territory, because nuclear weapons and territory are meaningless to that technology. #UFOTwitter #UFOs #UAPTwitter

Ross Coulthart says U.S. Naval scientists were briefed on Russia’s Yamantau Mountain Facility “Russia’s Area 51.”  Inside the Russians are working on free electron and gamma ray lasers, neutrino beams, ionospheric weapons, even scalar tech & micro black hole factories. 

Fun fact name for Yamantau Mountain comes from Bashkir word "Yaman tau"  which translates to "bad (evil) mountain.

Story of Natalia (Natalja Černohajev-Sticco) and her husband Gene (Sticco), who discovered a bundle of documents from Natalia's late father, Valerij Černohajev—a Soviet aerospace engineer. Contrary to the family's belief that he was a plumber, the documents reveal he worked on reverse-engineering non-human technology at a secretive Soviet facility akin to the U.S.'s Area 51.

 In 1989, the Soviets allegedly recovered a large Tic Tac-shaped craft (bigger than the famous one from the 2004 USS Nimitz encounter), including "bodies" (implying non-human biologics). This claim reportedly comes from sources like physicist Eric Davis, who has ties to classified programs and has briefed US officials on UAP (Unidentified Aerial Phenomena).

US General Keegan's public statement from 1977: he claimed the Soviets had achieved breakthroughs in charged particle beam (CPB) technology at sites like Semipalatinsk and Azgir, using fusion-pulsed magnetohydrodynamic generators to power beams capable of destroying missiles in flight.

We are living in twilight zone i can say that with high degree of certainty.
